title: The Sign of the Four
titlePt: Sherlock Holmes: O Signo dos Quatro

description.en: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson investigate a missing father, mysterious pearls, a stolen treasure, and a pact forged in colonial India.
description.pt: Sherlock Holmes e Dr. Watson investigam um pai desaparecido, pérolas misteriosas, um tesouro roubado e um pacto firmado na Índia colonial.
